page_title: ATM 2-1 RSO | Atletico Madrid v Real Sociedad 08/10/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+7' Javi Galan (Atl. Madrid) is cautioned and receives a yellow card.
90+6' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) was quite harsh and Jose Luis Munuera Montero didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
90+6' Alvaro Morata (Atl. Madrid) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked.
90+5' Aihen Munoz (Real Sociedad) picks up the rebound from his own attempted pass and decides to shoot from mid-range. He shouldn't have bothered as the ball flies miles over the bar.
90+5' The corner from Arsen Zakharyan (Real Sociedad) is hurriedly cleared.
90+4' Brais Mendez (Real Sociedad) floats the free kick into the box, but it's easily cleared by the first man.
90+3' Mario Hermoso (Atl. Madrid) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Jose Luis Munuera Montero blows for a foul.
90' 7 additional min. will be played.
90' Substitution. Umar Sadiq (Real Sociedad) replaces Mikel Oyarzabal.
90' Imanol Alguacil prepares a substitution. Ander Barrenetxea is replaced by Andre Silva (Real Sociedad).
89' 2 - 1 Goal! Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Alex Remiro into the bottom right corner.
88' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
87' Carlos Fernandez (Real Sociedad) goes into the book and receives a yellow card.
86' Carlos Fernandez (Real Sociedad) touches the ball with his hand inside the box! It's a penalty for Atl. Madrid!
86' Hamari Traore (Real Sociedad) is punished with a yellow card for violating the rules.
85' Alvaro Morata (Atl. Madrid) misses a rebound from the penalty spot. The ball flies just a few inches over the bar.
85' Rodrigo Riquelme (Atl. Madrid) gets inside the box and tries to beat Alex Remiro with a measured shot into the bottom right corner, but the keeper is equal to the effort and makes a fine save.

84' Martin Zubimendi (Real Sociedad) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Jose Luis Munuera Montero with no other option than to blow for a foul.
83' Igor Zubeldia (Real Sociedad) commits an ugly challenge. The referee sees it and immediately blows his whistle.
83' Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the middle of the target, but Jan Oblak easily deals with the threat.
81' Brais Mendez (Real Sociedad) produces a mid-range free kick, but fails to find the target. He curled the ball over the wall but his shot goes way wide of the left post.
80' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) was too forceful with his tackle and Jose Luis Munuera Montero interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
79' Here is a change. Cesar Azpilicueta is going off and Diego Simeone gives the last tactical orders to Stefan Savic (Atl. Madrid).
79' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Javi Galan (Atl. Madrid) is coming onto the pitch as Samuel Lino cannot continue after picking up an injury.
78' Arsen Zakharyan (Real Sociedad) bursts pass a defender and attempts to score from the edge of the area, but the shot goes high over the bar.
74' The referee blows for a cooling break.
73' 1 - 1 Amazing piece of skill! Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad) picks up a cross on the edge of the 18-yard box and hammers the ball precisely into the bottom left corner. What a finish!
72' Diego Simeone has decided to make a change. Saul Niguez (Atl. Madrid) replaces Rodrigo de Paul.
72' Substitution. Marcos Llorente is replaced by Rodrigo Riquelme (Atl. Madrid).
69' It’s the correct decision – NO PENALTY for Real Sociedad! VAR comes to the rescue of referee Jose Luis Munuera Montero and both teams have no complaints.

68' There's a break in play and referee Jose Luis Munuera Montero must have got a signal in his ear as he indicates he will check that earlier penalty claim by Real Sociedad using VAR. This could be interesting!

67' Brais Mendez (Real Sociedad) outjumps the defence to meet the resulting corner and heads the ball low to the middle of the goal. The long-range header is not powerful enough, and the keeper comfortably makes a save.
67' Surely that's handball by one of the Atl. Madrid players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
66' The ball is out of play. Real Sociedad win a corner kick.
65' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Takefusa Kubo leaves the pitch and Carlos Fernandez (Real Sociedad) comes on.
65' Substitution. Mikel Merino will be replaced by Arsen Zakharyan (Real Sociedad).
65' Imanol Alguacil decides to make a substitution. Robin Le Normand will be replaced by Jon Pacheco (Real Sociedad).
65' POST! Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad) unleashes a thunderous effort from the edge of the box and the ball crashes against the left post. What a strike that was!
63' A corner kick by Atl. Madrid is thwarted by the well prepared Alex Remiro (Real Sociedad).
63' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) sends a pass into the penalty area, but the opponent manages to cut it out. It will be a corner kick for Atl. Madrid.
61' Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates as he overhits the effort.
57' Chance! Brais Mendez (Real Sociedad) gets to the rebound on the edge of the box and smashes the ball towards the left side of the goal, but Jan Oblak is alert and makes a save to deny him.
54' The current number of corner kicks is 0:1.
54' Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.
50' The attendance is 65607.
48' Koke (Atl. Madrid) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
47' Axel Witsel (Atl. Madrid) hit the right post with his blast from close range after receiving a cross from the resulting free kick.
46' Hamari Traore (Real Sociedad) commits a rough challenge and Jose Luis Munuera Montero blows his whistle for a foul.
46' Jose Luis Munuera Montero blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+3' The end of the first half.

45+3' Chance! Takefusa Kubo sends a brilliant curling cross into the heart of the defence and into the path of Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad), whose header from the centre of the box goes a whisker over the bar.
45+1' Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) shows too much aggression during an attacking move and ends up fouling his opponent.
45' There will be a minimum of 3 min. of added time.

44' OFF THE POST! Rodrigo de Paul (Atl. Madrid) runs towards the goal to give his teammate support. He receives a fantastic pass and shoots from the edge of the box, but it crashes against the right post. It could have been a brilliant goal, unlucky.
43' Jose Luis Munuera Montero interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Igor Zubeldia (Real Sociedad).
34' Hamari Traore (Real Sociedad) manages to dispossess his opponent of the ball, but he commits a foul in the process and the referee blows his whistle.
30' A cooling break is underway.
25' Brais Mendez (Real Sociedad) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Jose Luis Munuera Montero signals.

22' 1 - 0 Koke sends a lovely ball into Samuel Lino (Atl. Madrid). He latches on to it and shoots into the bottom left corner from the edge of the box. The goalkeeper had no chance. The score changes to 1:0.

21' That didn't go as planned! Rodrigo de Paul (Atl. Madrid) tried his luck from the edge of the box, but his effort towards the middle of the goal was too weak to get past Alex Remiro, who easily kept it out.
15' Robin Le Normand (Real Sociedad) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
10' Brais Mendez (Real Sociedad) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
9' Nahuel Molina (Atl. Madrid) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Jose Luis Munuera Montero no option but to blow his whistle.
8' Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad) is adjudged offside.
1' Gooal! No wait, it's been ruled out for offside. Ander Barrenetxea (Real Sociedad) disagrees, but the linesman is sure about his call.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are on the pitch and Real Sociedad will have the kick-off.
Jose Luis Munuera Montero was nominated as the referee for this game.
Show lineups We now know the starting lineups. You can find them in the match details of this match.
